records.reason: Downtime lodging/meals for free; no sheet statistic changes and the app does not model downtime cost of living.
Upgrades the construct companion to a paragon construct companion (a real companion stat-block rank change on the sheet); no field in the legal set expresses a companion maturity/rank upgrade.
Grants an action that counteracts a mental effect on an ALLY; it changes an ally's condition, not the player's statistics.

You are affected by a constant Truespeech spell (permanent comprehension/speech of all languages, a sheet-visible language change). innateSpells only models per-day/at-will casts, and there is no language-grant field; the Mythic Point proficiency swap is table-side.
Grants the player resistance to physical damage equal to their level for a stated duration (until the beginning of their next turn) — a defence the IWR panel should show; nothing delivers it.

mode.name: Abjure Harm
mode.duration: until the beginning of your next turn
mode.note: After spending 1 Mythic Point on Abjure Harm, the triggering critical Strike becomes a regular hit and you have resistance to physical damage equal to your level until the beginning of your next turn.

records.reason: A success on a save against a non-damaging mental effect becomes a critical success — a degree-of-success upgrade on the player's own saves. situational only carries numeric bonuses, so no legal field expresses it.
An action that deals extra damage to the struck target; it changes only the target's statistics and is resolved at the table.
An action that deals damage to enemies in an area with a save against an already-derived DC; entirely target-side.
A reaction whose counteract check and –2 one-off save penalty are resolved at the table for a single triggering effect, and whose main benefit ends the effect for other creatures.
The benefit (ignoring difficult terrain in one chosen terrain) applies to the MOUNT and covers GM-adjudicated terrain the app does not model; a companion-only pick with no sheet statistic behind it.

Gated on being in a GM-adjudicated Favored Terrain and applies to environmental damage and temperature severity — neither environments nor temperature effects are modelled, and 'environmental' is not a damage type the resistances field takes.
Changes the action economy of the ALLY riding you; nothing on your own sheet changes.
Restructures the multiple attack penalty only inside the Impossible Flurry activity, whose attack sequence is resolved at the table.
A critical-hit rider that puts persistent mental damage on the target; it changes only the target's statistics.
A critical-hit rider that inflicts persistent void damage and stupefied on the target; target-side only (it is called a critical specialization effect, it does not grant critical specialization).
A reaction that rerolls one failed save; a fortune reroll resolved at the table, with a per-poison-type usage rule limitedUses cannot express.
While raging you gain imprecise scent 30 feet — a sense the sheet should list while the rage toggle is on; nothing delivers it.

mode.name: Acute Scent (Raging)
mode.note: While raging, you gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

records.reason: While raging you gain darkvision — a sense the sheet should list while the rage toggle is on; nothing delivers it.

mode.name: Acute Vision (Raging)
mode.note: While raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision.

records.reason: A reaction that applies resistance to a single triggering damage instance only; there is no duration to toggle, so it is resolved when the reaction is used.

Your stonestrike unarmed attacks count as adamantine — a material property of the player's own strikes that the strike breakdown and IWR bypass logic use; no legal field tags a strike's precious material.
You select four master and familiar abilities each day instead of two — a real increase in the number of familiar-ability picks the builder offers; no legal field sets the familiar ability count.
A free action at initiative that swaps one already-prepared tactic for another in your folio; an in-encounter swap resolved at the table.
Adds a trait to a signature trick and adjusts Perform a Trick penalties inside the Circus subsystem, which the app does not model; the checks are resolved at the table.
Grants an additional novice follower with the minion trait (repeatable up to four) — followers are real companion-side entities the app carries data for, and this record grants none.
Grants a fourth ikon of any type — an extra exemplar ikon selection the builder should offer; effectChoices has no ikon filter and the ikon list is too large to enumerate as options.
A free action granting an extra Recall Knowledge check; resolved at the table with no sheet statistic change.
Raises versatile vials per day to 5 (then 6, then 7 on repeat takes) — a tracked daily resource count on the sheet; no legal field sets a class resource total.
Lets you create 4 alchemical consumables during daily preparations — the app models Advanced Alchemy, and this record sets no item count for the dedication.

Grants proficiency with all advanced bows as if they were martial weapons; without it the app computes untrained attack bonuses for advanced bows. No legal field expresses a weapon-category proficiency grant.
Upgrades the construct companion to an advanced construct companion (a real companion stat change) and grants it a free action each round; no legal field expresses a companion maturity upgrade.
Raises the advanced alchemy item maximum to 8 + Int (10 + Int at 16th) — a number the modelled Advanced Alchemy panel should show; no legal field sets it.
Treats advanced firearms as martial for proficiency and grants access to all uncommon firearms — both a strike attack-bonus change and an item-access change; no legal field expresses either.
Expands what Administer First Aid can do for an ALLY (reducing frightened/sickened); an ally-side skill action resolved at the table.
Raises herbal items created per day with advanced alchemy to 6 (8 on a second take) — a tracked daily item count; no legal field sets it.
Treats advanced monk weapons as martial monk weapons for proficiency, changing the attack bonus on those strikes; no legal field expresses a weapon-category proficiency grant.

Grants the greater order benefit of whichever Hellknight order you belong to — a concrete benefit conditional on an earlier choice; nothing grants it and no legal field expresses a choice-dependent grant of another record.
Raises poisons created per day with advanced alchemy to 6 (8 on a second take) — a tracked daily item count; no legal field sets it.
You gain a 3rd-rank qi spell of your choice (Qi Blast, Shrink the Span, or another) — a focus-spell pick the builder should offer; nothing offers it.

effectChoices.prompt: Advanced Qi Spells: choose a 3rd-rank qi spell (such as Qi Blast or Shrink the Span)

records.reason: Grants proficiency with all advanced firearms as martial firearms and all advanced crossbows as martial crossbows, changing strike attack bonuses; no legal field expresses a weapon-category proficiency grant.
A 2-action ability that temporarily makes the Absorb into the Aegis reaction available; an in-encounter action grant resolved at the table.
The benefit is whatever resonant power the aeon stone you own provides; it is an item-driven daily selection from inventory, not a fixed grant this record can express.
An impulse that deals area damage to creatures with a save against an already-derived class DC; entirely target-side.
An attack action with extra damage and prone/grab outcomes on the target; resolved at the table, target-side.
Extends Mercy to counteract afflictions on the ally you touch; it changes an ally's conditions, not your statistics.
An initiative-time free action to act last and gain panache; initiative order and panache are toggled in play, not derived on the sheet.

Turns your own critical failures on Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks into failures (with a fortune reroll versus orcs) — a degree-of-success adjustment on the player's own skill checks that no legal field expresses.
A critical-hit rider adding persistent poison damage to the target; target-side only.
A free action after Shield Block that Shoves the triggering enemy or makes it off-guard; entirely target-side.

Your multiple attack penalty with agile weapons and agile unarmed attacks becomes –3/–6 instead of –4/–8 — the strike breakdown shows MAP, so this is a wrong number without a fix; no legal field alters MAP.

Disarm, Grapple, Reposition, Shove, and Trip use –4/–8 MAP even with non-agile weapons, and –3/–6 with an agile weapon while you have panache; a real change to the player's own attack math that no legal field expresses.

A toggled grip that drops shield boss/shield spikes damage dice to 1d4 and gives those Strikes the agile trait — it rewrites the player's own strike line, and modes carry only numeric modifiers, not weapon damage dice or traits.
A successful Demoralize makes the enemy take recurring damage; the damage and its scaling land entirely on the target.
A reaction that slows another creature's fall; falling damage for a target is resolved at the table.
Changes Identify Alchemy from 10 minutes to a single action; an action-economy change to a skill use resolved at the table.
Permits Crafting alchemical items and adds four formulas to a formula book; Craft is a downtime activity and the app models no formula book (only free-text craftRequirements).
You become an EXPERT in the alchemist class DC — a proficiency rank on a derived sheet number (the class DC shown for the dedication); nothing raises it, and no legal field sets class DC proficiency.
A 2-action Strike that converts a consumed bomb into damage and persistent damage on the target; resolved at the table.
A reaction to make a Strike or Disarm attempt against the triggering opponent; resolved at the table with no sheet change.

Free lodging is flavour, the Dueling Lore-for-Diplomacy substitution is GM-adjudicated by target, and the 5/10 temporary HP is gained per successful Strike during play (temporary HP is entered in play, not derived).
Grants an extra reaction each turn usable only for specific dueling reactions; reaction economy is tracked at the table, not on the sheet.
